_readme: Single source of truth for prices. The server reads this file to compute every charge, so the browser can never set a price. 'from' is the starting price for custom work; the deposit is depositRate x from. Premade items are charged their full price. To sell a ready-made item, add it to 'premade' (image goes in /img/shop/). Set 'visible' to false to hide one.
